title: Brian Daboll: Cam Ward can do a lot of things, "big factor" in taking Titans OC job

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Brian Daboll: Cam Ward can do a lot of things, "big factor" in taking Titans OC job
sources.description: Brian Daboll worked with the second quarterback drafted in 2025 before being fired as the Giants' head coach and he'll get a chance to work with the first one in his new job.
